items.material:
Wu Zeyin,14,comes from Hubei,China.He finds that many fruits and vegetables(蔬菜) in Botswana are very small.And some of them are not good.The carrots are small and the tomatoes are green.But the price(价格) is very <u>high</u>.And he learns that Botswana has to buy many fruits and vegetables from other places.Wu wants to do something to help.
He made an app(应用程序) for agriculture(农业)—Farm Assistant.With the help of the app,farmers can know the vegetables’ planting time,watering needs and ripening(成熟) time.
Wu says,“<u>It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.</u>”
